[[Category:Legal entity]]
'''Legal identity''' is a set of information that fully identifies a [[legal identity]] beyond any reasonable doubt, sanctioned by law.<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>

== For a person ==

Although the exact set of legally identifying information varies by [[jurisdiction]], in general they contain

* Given and family name
* Date and place of birth
* Nationality (especially concerning immigration/marriage/international law, etc.)
* Parental links (especially in case of ambiguity)

<ref>{{#cite:Q3952}}</ref>
